name: Danger Levels
lines: Dreamers fight only when both agree: challenge someone, and they accept. Beaten, you lose nothing.
Any grown-up may attack another out in the open. Beaten, you wake by the way in and lose nothing.
Any grown-up may attack another out in the open. Beaten, you wake by the way in, and the winner takes a twentieth of your purse (at most 250 gold).
Anything goes. Beaten, the winner takes a tenth of your purse (at most 1,000 gold).
The great cities of the dream lands
Somnucor: the streets, every building, the Nightmare Wilds
Your own dream, and any dream you visit
The hidden Crescent casino on the Moon
Veyar and Ilvessa, the Singing City
The Endless Sea, the Odyssey islands and Saltcrown
The Kids Zone in Faerie (always safe)
The City to Come and Brightwater
The Land of the Dead and Lanternhome
Indoors, and round the way in, nobody can be hurt.
Sign in to take part; until then nobody can fight you.
Fights happen only out in the open: indoors, and round the way into every world, nobody can be hurt. Under 18, or under a family lock, nobody can fight you anywhere.
In a dream land itself you are in your own dream, which is always safe. These are for the great city through each land's gate, where other dreamers are.

The workshop stove eats logs all night. Three armfuls from the woodpile by my hut to the log basket at the workshop door would warm a hundred elves.
The log basket by the workshop door
Santa's reindeer need their supper. Fetch hay from the bales at the end of the stable, and give a forkful to Dasher, Vixen, Donner, and Rudolph last of all.
The post box is full to the brim with letters. Carry the sacks to Penwick at the Office of the List, out past the workshop, so every letter is read.
It snowed again in the night (it always does). Six drifts are blocking the paths round the green. A shovel is by each one.

The elves out at the far workshops have been at it since dawn. Take a mug of cocoa to Tamsin at the Foundry, Fizz at the Toy-Testing Hall, Sorrel at the Flying Paddock and Tansy at the Wrapping House.
The cocoa table by the hut
A basket of toys came back from testing a little worse for wear. At the mending bench by my hut: glue, sand, paint, varnish, and a new tag.
The lamp posts round the great tree have lost their lights. Hang a fresh string on each of the six, and the green will glow again.
A lamp post by the great tree
The elves' gift room opens very soon.
Help the elves, by your own good will
"Nobody has to, and nobody is paid: you help because you want to. But every job done, the elves make you something on the spot, and no two of their gifts are ever alike."
You can start it again any time
You put the job down. Clementine smiles: "Any help is help."
Sign in to be given the elves' gifts. You can still help without.
Follow the arrow on the banner, and the golden ring.
The elves have given you all their gifts for today. Come back tomorrow: your help still counts.
One of a kind: there is no other like it anywhere. It is in your Backpack, to keep, or to give to a dreamer beside you.
You step away before it is done. Come back to the golden ring to finish.
Stand beside the dreamer you want to give it to (within a few steps), then open your Backpack again.
Who should have it? It will be theirs, and no longer yours.
Jobs at the Helpers' Hut on the green; every one done earns a one-of-a-kind gift
